lines.en: : Okay well, maybe I {i}did{/i} wake up a little horny today...
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许我今天早上醒来{i}确实{/i}有点发情……

lines.en: : But it’s not like I’m gonna just ask you to fuck me in the bathroom or anything.
lines.zh: : 可我也不至于就这么叫你去洗手间操我什么的。
: 那也太荒唐了。哈哈哈哈哈~
: 哈哈哈……哈哈哈……啊哈哈哈……

lines.en: Welp, I think it’s safe to say I know where this is headed.
lines.zh: 好吧，我想可以肯定地说，我知道这事要往哪儿发展了。

lines.en: Is it really okay to be doing something like this, though? If anything, it feels like she’s about to close the place up for the sole purpose of having sex.
lines.zh: 不过，做这种事真的没问题吗？怎么看都像是她要为了做爱而关店。

lines.en: And I’ve become incredibly...aware of how much Haruka likes sex as of late, but even I don’t know if I’d close my business to fuck someone.
lines.zh: 我最近已经非常……清楚 Haruka 有多喜欢做爱了，可就连我也不知道自己会不会为了跟谁上床而关店。

lines.en: But at the same time, I’m willing to have sex with my students during work-hours, so I guess I’m not really that strong-willed either.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我也愿意在工作时间跟我的学生做爱，所以我想我的意志力也没那么强。
: 嗯，那个。
: 你好啊，Haruka。

lines.en: : Can I be really direct for a second?
lines.zh: : 我能直说一会儿吗？
: ……可以，Haruka。

lines.en: : Do you wanna like, you know...go fuck me in the bathroom or whatever?
lines.zh: : 你要不要，那个……去洗手间操我什么的？

lines.en: : I’m kind of curious about what the “whatever” part means.
lines.zh: : 我还挺好奇「什么的」指的是什么。
: 哈哈，是——啊。我也想知道。

lines.en: : Either way, I’m down if you’re really okay with closing the store early for something like that.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，如果你真的愿意为这种事提前关店，我没问题。

lines.en: : I've gotta say, though. I’m surprised at how quickly you’re warming up to {i}us{/i} despite how you felt at-
lines.zh: : 不过我得说，我很惊讶你这么快就对{i}我们{/i}热络起来了，尽管你之前的感受——
: 别说了。

lines.en: : Don’t say what you were about to say. I don’t want to think about it.
lines.zh: : 别把你刚才要说的话说出来。我不想去想那件事。
: 哦，好。行。

lines.en: : Well, uhh, anyway! I guess just...follow me?
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃，总之！你就……跟我来吧？

lines.en: Haruka gets off of the couch and moves over to the glass door, locking it and quickly trotting back to the counter to meet me.
lines.zh: Haruka 从沙发上起来，走到玻璃门前把门锁上，又小跑回柜台来找我。

lines.en: Our eyes lock for a brief moment and she winks at me, sticking her tongue out playfully.
lines.zh: 我们的目光短暂交汇，她冲我眨了下眼，调皮地吐了吐舌头。

lines.en: And even though we only maintain eye contact for a second or two, I can see her face beginning to turn red-
lines.zh: 尽管我们的对视只持续了一两秒，我还是能看到她的脸开始泛红——

lines.en: And tears beginning to well up.
lines.zh: 还有眼泪开始涌上来。

lines.en: : Yeah, so, sorry we’re in the bathroom and whatnot. But you know, glass doors and stuff.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个，抱歉我们是在洗手间里什么的。不过你也知道，玻璃门什么的。

lines.en: : I can’t even believe we’re about to do this in here to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我简直不敢相信我们居然要在这儿做这种事。

lines.en: : I guess it {i}does{/i} make me feel a little younger, though...
lines.zh: : 不过这{i}确实{/i}让我感觉年轻了一点……

lines.en: : And there's no way I'd complain about that. Hahahah...
lines.zh: : 这种事我可不会抱怨。哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I know. Not a great look for me...Having to force you into an enclosed space just to have sex.
lines.zh: : 好好好。我知道。这看起来可不怎么光彩……把你逼进一个封闭的空间，就为了做爱。
: 对不起。

lines.en: : There’s no need to apologize. It’s not like I don’t enjoy this.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉。我又不是不享受。

lines.en: : Not sure if you know this or not, but you’re kind of really...exciting when it comes to sex.
lines.zh: : 不知道你清不清楚，你在性这件事上真的非常……带劲。
: 带劲？怎么说？

lines.en: : You’re not just talking about my boobs, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会只是在说我的奶子吧？

lines.en: : Of course not...Though, those definitely are a plus.
lines.zh: : 当然不是……不过那些确实是加分项。

lines.en: : Thanks. I was really self conscious of them when they finally started growing in, but now I think they’re pretty frickin’ awesome.
lines.zh: : 谢了。它们刚长出来的时候我特别难为情，不过现在我觉得它们他妈的棒极了。

lines.en: : So they haven't always been that large?
lines.zh: : 所以它们不是一直这么大？

lines.en: : Uh...no. But just having boobs is enough to warrant all kinds of guys staring at them, even if they're not that big.
lines.zh: : 呃……不是。不过光是有胸部，就足够招来各种各样的男人盯着看了，哪怕它们没那么大。

lines.en: I wonder what Haruka looked like back then?
lines.zh: 我想知道 Haruka 那时候是什么样子？

lines.en: Granted, she’s not really old or anything now since she’s only in her early thirties or late twenties...But still, that’s definitely something I would have liked to see.
lines.zh: 当然，她现在也算不上老，毕竟才三十出头或者二十来岁末……不过话说回来，那绝对是我乐意看一眼的。

lines.en: : So umm, I’m like really {i}really{/i} horny, so the sooner we do this, the better.
lines.zh: : 那个，我真是{i}非常、非常{/i}想要，所以我们越早开始越好。

lines.en: : Before we do that, though...there is something I want you to do today.
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前……今天有件事我想让你做。

lines.en: : Oh? And what might that be?~
lines.zh: : 哦？那会是什么呢？~

lines.en: : A while ago, when I ran into you and Sara at that one bistro, I remember her saying something about you being into roleplay.
lines.zh: : 不久前，我在那家小餐馆偶遇你和 Sara，我记得她说起过你喜欢角色扮演。

lines.zh: : 我们不用{i}立刻{/i}就开始角色扮演，不过我想让你从现在起换个方式称呼我。

lines.en: : Oh, uhh, sure. I don’t mind that at all. Just tell me what you want to hear and I’ll do it. Nothing’s off the table.
